text.name: mm_build_partial
text.text: partly: some changes sit inside another mod's version and stay

text.name: mm_build_noBase
text.text: not possible: the game's original of this function is unknown

text.name: mm_build_unsafe
text.text: not possible: this chain is only partly readable, left alone to be safe

text.name: mm_chain_head
text.text: How it runs now (outermost first, it has the last word):

text.name: mm_layer_append
text.text: adds its code after the rest

text.name: mm_layer_prepend
text.text: adds its code before the rest

text.name: mm_layer_overwrite
text.text: wraps the rest and decides whether it runs

text.name: mm_layer_replace
text.text: put in its own version of the function

text.name: mm_ex_lost
text.text: %s changed this function, but %s replaced it afterwards without passing that change on, so the change from %s never runs.

text.name: mm_ex_lostLikely
text.text: %s changed this function, then %s put in its own version and the change is gone (ModMux saw the change made, not removed). The change from %s most likely never runs.

text.name: mm_ex_lostFix
text.text: Pick a winner, or turn on the shared chain so both changes run (the lost one goes back on top).

text.name: mm_ex_replaced
text.text: %s put in its own version of this function. The changes below it from %s only run if that version passes them on.

text.name: mm_ex_replacedWatch
text.text: ModMux finds out while you play: once the function has run a few times, this shows whether they still run.

text.name: mm_ex_hiddenRuns
text.text: Seen while playing: the change from %s still runs.

text.name: mm_ex_lostSeen
text.text: %s changed this function, then %s put in its own version that doesn't pass the change on: the function ran %d times since loading, the change from %s not once.

text.name: mm_ex_lostEarlier
text.text: %s changed this function, then %s put in its own version that doesn't pass the change on (seen on an earlier load). The change from %s doesn't run.

text.name: mm_ex_overwrite
text.text: %s wraps this function and decides whether the rest runs. If it skips the original, the changes below it (%s) don't run.

text.name: mm_ex_blockFix
text.text: If something of the inner mod doesn't work, pick it as winner or raise it in the ranking.

text.name: mm_ex_shared
text.text: Every change runs, in this order: %s. The last one has the last word.

text.name: mm_ex_sharedFix
text.text: Usually fine. If two mods set the same value, the later one wins: change the order with the ranking.

text.name: mm_ex_types
text.text: In %d type(s), %s each change %s. The game chains them itself: each one gets the previous one and decides whether it runs.

text.name: mm_ex_typesReadOnly
text.text: Shown for information. The game builds these chains per vehicle, ModMux doesn't change them.

text.name: mm_ex_locked_core
text.text: Locked: this belongs to the game's core (loading, menus, the mod system). ModMux never changes it.

text.name: mm_ex_locked_load
text.text: Locked: this runs while loading. Changing it could stop the game from loading, so ModMux never does.

text.name: mm_ex_locked_save
text.text: Locked: this saves your game. Changing it could lose data, so ModMux never does.

text.name: mm_ex_locked_network
text.text: Locked: this keeps multiplayer in sync. Changing it on one side only would break that, so ModMux never does.

text.name: mm_simple_unranked
text.text: Not ranked: follows the load order.

text.name: mm_simple_help
text.text: Raise a mod to make it win its fights: its changes run last and get the last word. Ranked mods beat unranked ones. Applies on the next load.

text.name: mm_category_help
text.text: This ranking only counts in %s and comes before the overall one.

text.name: mm_confirm_resetRank
text.text: Remove every mod from the ranking? The load order decides again from the next load.

text.name: mm_confirm_resume
text.text: Turn ModMux's levers back on? Your picks, rankings and parked mods apply again from the next load.

text.name: mm_confirm_suspend
text.text: Turn every lever off? From the next load ModMux only watches and changes nothing. Your setup is kept.

text.name: mm_confirm_loadProfile
text.text: Load the profile '%s'? It replaces your current picks, rankings and parked mods (from the next load); live settings change at once.

text.name: mm_info_hudScan
text.text: Close the menu and play on: for about 5 seconds ModMux notes where each mod draws. The result shows up here in REVIEW.

text.name: mm_sub_conflicts
text.text: View: %s | %d conflicts: %d lost, %d may block, %d shared

text.name: mm_sub_early
text.text: | %d mod(s) loaded before ModMux, not watched

text.name: mm_sub_vehicle
text.text: The vehicle you sit in, updated twice a second

text.name: mm_sub_perf
text.text: Frame %.1f ms (%d fps) | mods %.2f ms | budget %d fps = %.1f ms

text.name: mm_sub_review_never
text.text: HUD overlap scan: not run yet (runs a minute into play, or press Scan HUD)

text.name: mm_sub_review_running
text.text: HUD overlap scan: running, close the menu for a few seconds

text.name: mm_footer_ok
text.text: Picks, rankings and parking apply on the next load. Nothing is waiting.

text.name: mm_footer_pending
text.text: %d change(s) wait for the next load. Save and restart the game to apply them.

text.name: mm_footer_safe_killSwitch
text.text: SAFE MODE: MODMUX_SAFE_MODE.txt is in modSettings/FS25_ModMux. Every lever is off; delete the file to turn them back on.

text.name: mm_footer_safe_lastLaunch
text.text: SAFE MODE: the last start didn't finish, so every lever is off. Turn them back on when you're ready.

text.name: mm_footer_safe_abnormal
text.text: SAFE MODE: the last load came up without its farms, so every lever is off.

text.name: mm_footer_safe_suspended
text.text: Levers are off: ModMux only watches. Turn them back on with the button.

text.name: mm_footer_safeResumed
text.text: Levers are off for this load and come back on with the next one.

text.name: mm_empty_conflicts
text.text: No conflicts: no two mods change the same function.

text.name: mm_empty_noOwners
text.text: ModMux can't tell which mod a function comes from in this game version, so it can't find conflicts. The details are in modSettings/FS25_ModMux/ModMux.log.

text.name: mm_empty_conflictsEarly
text.text: No conflicts among the mods ModMux watched. %d mod(s) loaded before it and can't be watched: keep the zip named %s so it loads first.

text.name: mm_empty_vehicle
text.text: Get into a vehicle to see its numbers.

text.name: mm_empty_perf
text.text: Measuring... numbers show after a few frames.

text.name: mm_empty_perfOff
text.text: Timers are off (safe mode or switched off). Turn them on: applies on the next load.

text.name: mm_empty_profiles
text.text: No profiles yet. Save the current setup as a new profile.

text.name: mm_live_help
text.text: Changes apply at once. ModMux remembers the value and gives it back next time.

text.name: mm_live_warn_desc
text.text: A message a few seconds into play when mods are flatly incompatible or switch each other's changes off.

text.name: mm_live_budget_desc
text.text: The frame rate you aim for. PERFORMANCE shows each mod's cost as a share of one frame at this rate.

text.name: mm_live_hudScan
text.text: HUD overlap scan a minute into play

text.name: mm_live_hudScan_desc
text.text: Notes for a few seconds where each mod draws on screen and reports mods drawing over each other.

text.name: mm_veh_wheelHelp
text.text: Grip is the tyre's friction on what it stands on (1.00 = the game's normal). Slip is how much the wheel spins faster than the vehicle moves.

text.name: mm_veh_noFights
text.text: No two mods change the same function of this vehicle type.

text.name: mm_veh_live
text.text: Live value, read from the vehicle.

text.name: mm_perf_avg
text.text: Average %.2f ms per frame, peak %.2f ms

text.name: mm_perf_parkHelp
text.text: Parking stops this mod's own per-frame work (its update and draw) from the next load, without uninstalling it. Its vehicles and buildings keep working; its HUD, timers and automation stop.

text.name: mm_perf_cantPark
text.text: This mod has no event listener ModMux could park.

text.name: mm_rev_help_duplicate
text.text: Two copies of one mod can fight each other. Keep the newer one and remove the other from your mods folder.

text.name: mm_rev_help_incompatible
text.text: These two are known not to work together. Use one of them.

text.name: mm_rev_help_hard
text.text: See CONFLICTS (ADVANCED) for each function: pick a winner or turn on the shared chain.

text.name: mm_rev_help_hud
text.text: Both draw on the same part of the screen. Move one of them in its own settings, or park one.

text.name: mm_ev_dupReason_name
text.text: Same file name apart from a copy or version suffix.

text.name: mm_ev_knownPair
text.text: Listed in ModMux's list of known incompatible mods.

text.name: mm_ev_hardCount
text.text: In %d function(s) the change is gone:

text.name: mm_ev_hudWhere
text.text: Both draw at the %s %s of the screen.

text.name: mm_profile_counts
text.text: %d conflict picks, %d ranked mods, %d parked mods, %d live settings

text.name: mm_profile_help
text.text: Loading a profile replaces your picks, rankings and parked mods (they apply on the next load); its live settings change at once.

text.name: mm_notify_flat
text.text: ModMux: %d pair(s) of mods don't work together. ESC menu > ModMux > REVIEW.

text.name: mm_notify_lost
text.text: ModMux: %d mod change(s) are switched off by other mods. ESC menu > ModMux > CONFLICTS.

text.name: mm_notify_safe_killSwitch
text.text: ModMux safe mode (MODMUX_SAFE_MODE.txt): every lever is off.

text.name: mm_notify_safe_lastLaunch
text.text: ModMux safe mode: the last start didn't finish, so every lever is off. ESC menu > ModMux.

text.name: mm_notify_safe_abnormal
text.text: ModMux safe mode: the last load came up without its farms, so every lever is off.

text.name: mm_notify_abnormal
text.text: ModMux: this savegame loaded without its farms. Saving is blocked so your savegame on disk stays safe. Quit without saving.

text.name: mm_notify_saveBlocked
text.text: ModMux: not saved. This load came up without its farms; your savegame on disk is untouched.
